searchText: Not the final Shanghai test pack, but we have a lot of new tests for a package. EIPTests folder is not mandatory to pass and can contain tests out of specs https://github.com/ethereum/tests/releases/tag/v11.3 I'm getting `genesis block hash doesn't match test: computed=151934ad9b65, test=18db39e19931` in `TestBlockchain/ValidBlocks/bcExample/shanghaiExample.json` Can be related because of a wrong withdrawals root in genesis header Yeah, withdrawalsRoot should probably be 0x56e81f171bcc55a6ff8345e692c0f86e5b48e01b996cadc001622fb5e363b421 rather than 0x1dcc4de8dec75d7aab85b567b6ccd41ad312451b948a7413f0a142fd40d49347

excerpts.author: dimitry8570
excerpts.content:
Not the final Shanghai test pack, but we have a lot of new tests for a package.
EIPTests folder is not mandatory to pass and can contain tests out of specs
